source_definition.paper: Abnormal Event Detection at 150 FPS in Matlab, ICCV 2013
source_definition.notes: Survey descriptions further identify running, throwing objects, loitering, wrong-direction motion, and people carrying abnormal objects such as bicycles.

object_prompt_rationale: The prompt emphasizes visible entities associated with Avenue anomalies: people and abnormal people/action states, bicycles/skateboards/carts, bags/luggage, and thrown or abnormal objects.
